newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STANDARD TO INCREASE ITS SHARE CAPITAL-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: STANDARD TO INCREASE ITS SHARE CAPITAL-REPORT.

text.p: The council of Standard, one of Estonia's largest furniture producers, on Wednesday decided to raise its share capital from 920,000 kroons to at least 20 million kroons, Aripaev newspaper said on Thursday.
New share capital will be between 20 and 30 million kroons, chairman Enn Veskimagi was quoted as saying.
The company will raise the capital from retained profits and reserves.
The council also decided to take the company's shares to the bourse. Veskimagi said the preparations will start in August to get the shares listed in September.
Standard had a turnover of 47 million kroons and profit 7.4 million kroons during the four months this year.
